This section contains the guided exercises completed for ISSS626. Each exercise page can be extended with R code, maps, explanations, and reflections.

## Hands-on Exercise 1A

::: {.exercise-card}
### Geospatial Data Science with R

This exercise focuses on importing and inspecting geospatial data, working with simple feature objects, checking coordinate reference systems, and preparing spatial data for analysis.

**Main tools:** `sf`, base R, data wrangling

**Status:** Page structure prepared for coursework.
:::

## Hands-on Exercise 1B

::: {.exercise-card}
### Thematic Mapping and Geovisualisation with R

This exercise focuses on choropleth maps, data classification, colour schemes, map layout, and communicating spatial patterns clearly.

**Main tools:** `tmap`, classification methods, cartographic design

**Status:** Page structure prepared for coursework.
:::

## Reproducible workflow

New exercises can be added as individual `.qmd` files. R code is executed during the local Quarto render, and the generated `_site` folder is published through Netlify.
